Round-3 final QA2 item 7: S13 capped three crp land cells (TLS, TTO, LBY) whose held income tax exceeded the fitted land rent and dropped 68 m. GTAP 12 ch.15 p.2 gives the corporate income tax to the non-labour factors pro rata, and ch.17B p.3 forbids sign violations (EVOS >= 0). method.cap_land_income_tax caps the income tax of every land cell at 99 percent of its land rent (EVFP) less its positive factor-use tax, the floor S13 uses (s13_fit.method.EVOS_FLOOR_SHARE = 0.01, so the cell keeps 1 percent of its rent as operating surplus); the excess is dropped, not moved to other factors, and ledgered (LAND-ITAX-CAPPED); S12-Htax nets it, S12-Hlanditax checks the cap.
